thread_extension: How it works: DocParse is a layout-aware API that extracts line items, totals, tax fields, and vendor data from invoices, receipts, and POs into structured JSON. p95 latency is 1.8 seconds per page, tracked on a public metrics page.

Accuracy claims without methodology are noise. Ours come with a published benchmark — 5,000 invoices, field-level scoring, full methodology. You can read it before you write a line of integration code.
Designed for AP automation and ERP integration at volume. Usage-based pricing starts at $0.01 per page with volume tiers. SOC 2 Type I report available under NDA; Type II audit in progress.
